text: Bitcoin's modest 1% gain contrasts with Ethereum's stronger 4.4% rally, suggesting traders are rotating toward altcoin exposure despite extreme fear conditions. The Fear & Greed index at 21 indicates capitulation sentiment, yet the steady 8-point weekly climb and solid $86B trading volume hint that selling pressure may be stabilizing. Bitcoin's 55.6% dominance remains elevated but has room to compress further if this shift toward Ethereum and smaller caps persists.
